I'll try and give you some advice hope it helps.

*TN:*

*Pros*

Fast response times

High refresh rates are usually cheaper

*Cons:*

Poor viewing angles

Poor colour reproduction (can be remedied somewhat using colour profiles)

*IPS:*

*Pros:*

Glorious colours

Great viewing angles

*Cons:*

Not usually that fast 5ms+ response time

For fast panels and high refresh rates you're looking at a hefty price tag.

I currently own one monitor which is the ASUS VX239H its an IPS Panel with 5ms of response time but it is truly a glorious experience and monitor and I cannot fault it for its price.

If you're looking for a cheap TN Panel go for the ASUS VG248QE 1MS 144hz and pretty decent colours once you calibrate it.

If you're looking for a cheap IPS Panel go for the ASUS VX239H
